Ashfield Capital Partners Stake in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Has Increased by $378,572 as Share Value Rose; Merck & Co (MRK) Stock Value Declined While Sanders Capital Has Decreased Its Position by $374.55 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Sanders Capital Llc decreased its stake in Merck & Co Inc (MRK) by 63.13% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sanders Capital Llc sold 6.14M shares as the company’s stock declined 4.63% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.59M shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $220.47M, down from 9.73M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sanders Capital Llc who had been investing in Merck & Co Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $157.99B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.70% or $0.41 during the last trading session, reaching $58.73. About 2.18M shares traded. Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) has declined 14.94% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.49% the S&P500.
Ashfield Capital Partners Llc increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 12.11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ashfield Capital Partners Llc bought 2,201 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 20,369 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.51M, up from 18,168 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ashfield Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $505.98 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.98% or $1.92 during the last trading session, reaching $196.92. About 8.00M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Among 39 analysts covering Alibaba ( NYSE:BABA ), 37 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 95% are positive. Alibaba had 178 analyst reports since August 12, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Wednesday, August 26, the company rating was maintained by M Partners. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank with “Buy” on Monday, April 25. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Monday, January 25. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Outperform” rating and $110 target in Friday, August 12 report. The stock has “Buy” rating by SunTrust on Thursday, November 2. The firm has “Buy” rating by Axiom Capital given on Monday, September 14. As per Friday, August 12, the company rating was maintained by Citigroup. On Friday, August 12 the stock rating was maintained by Suntrust Robinson with “Buy”. The stock has “Hold” rating by TH Capital on Friday, August 14. Oppenheimer maintained Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) on Thursday, September 17 with “Outperform” rating.

(FB), Apple Inc. (AAPL) and Alibaba Group Holding Ltd (BABA)” on May 17, 2018. More interesting news about Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) were released by: Livetradingnews.com and their article: “Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) Stock Overbought” published on May 21, 2018 as well as Benzinga.com ‘s news article titled: “Upcoming Earnings: Alibaba Reports Before Market Open On Friday” with publication date: May 03, 2018.
Ashfield Capital Partners Llc, which manages about $2.94 billion and $777.43M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Pioneer Nat Res Co (NYSE:PXD) by 2,475 shares to 25,643 shares, valued at $4.43M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Starbucks Corp (NASDAQ:SBUX) by 17,001 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 64,340 shares, and cut its stake in Honeywell Intl Inc (NYSE:HON).
More notable recent Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) news were published by: Seekingalpha.com which released: “Congo’s Ebola outbreak in ‘new phase'” on May 17, 2018, also Seekingalpha.com with their article: “Congo begins Ebola vaccinations” published on May 21, 2018, Fool.com published: “Better Buy: Pfizer Inc. (PFE) vs. Merck (MRK)” on May 13, 2018. More interesting news about Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) were released by: 247Wallst.com and their article: “What to Look For in the Merck and Pfizer Reports Tuesday Morning” published on April 30, 2018 as well as Benzinga.com ‘s news article titled: “Keytruda Is Key To The Merck Thesis, Goldman Sachs Says In Upgrade” with publication date: April 23, 2018.
Analysts await Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) to report earnings on July, 27. They expect $1.04 earnings per share, up 2.97% or $0.03 from last year’s $1.01 per share. MRK’s profit will be $2.80 billion for 14.12 P/E if the $1.04 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.05 actual earnings per share reported by Merck & Co., Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -0.95% negative EPS growth.
Sanders Capital Llc, which manages about $15.69B and $19.90 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Citigroup Inc (NYSE:C) by 164,600 shares to 12.65M shares, valued at $1.02 billion in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Bank Amer Corp (NYSE:BAC) by 534,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 30.42M shares, and has risen its stake in Intel Corp (NASDAQ:INTC).
